preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setShares` function with both `_marketingShareNew` and `burnShareNew` arguments set to 0. This will update the `totalDistributionShares` state variable to zero, creating a division-by-zero condition in the `swapAndLiquify` function which can lead to a Denial of Service on token transfers.
